Declared HS set was 090230;090240;847130;851712 — the observed records cover only 090240 (black tea, 09024010/09024020); no shipment rows were seen for 090230, 847130 (laptops) or 851712 (phones), so those three codes are unconfirmed for this entity. Slug variants 'global-ventures-mangalore' and 'global-ventures-india' returned empty pages. Revenue and export volume: null (not public on free views). No rejection grounds: entity appears active in customs data.
